text.en:
26th. JUNE, 2018 No. S 31

TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING ORDER, 2015 (S 6112015) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 111) of the Town and Country Planning Order, 2015, the Minister of Development, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st January 2017 as the date on which that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 12th. day of Syawal, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of June, 2018.

DATO SERI PADUKA AWANG HAJI SUHAIMI BIN HAJJ GAFAR Minister of Development, Brunei Darussalam.
